text.en:
4. Ingin Jadi Nasrallah

Dibuat 15 Januari 2019

[KDN.PKK.S.600-1/1/3 Jld. 3; PN(PU2)417/XXIV]

TAN SRI DATO' HAJI MUHYIDDIN BIN HAJI MOHD YASSIN

Menteri Dalam Negeri

PRINTING PRESSES AND PUBLICATIONS ACT 1984

PRINTING PRESSES AND PUBLICATIONS

(CONTROL OF UNDESIRABLE PUBLICATIONS) (REVOCATION) ORDER 2019

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 7(1) of the

Printing Presses and Publications Act 1984 [Act 301], the Minister revokes the

prohibition of printing, importation, production, reproduction, publishing, sale, issue,

circulation, distribution or possession of publications specified in the Schedule which

have been published vide the Printing Presses and Publications (Control of Undesirable

Publications) (No. 2) Order 2015 [P.U. (A) 67/2015].

SCHEDULE

1. Sebongkah Batu Di Kuala Berang

2. Karbala

3. Tiga Kali Seminggu

4. Ingin Jadi Nasrallah

Made 15 January 2019

[KDN.PKK.S.600-1/1/3 Jld. 3; PN(PU2)417/XXIV]

TAN SRI DATO' HAJI MUHYIDDIN BIN HAJI MOHD YASSIN

Minister Of Home Affairs
